description: Emitted when every signer in an `com.etzhayyim.esign.envelope` has produced a valid `com.etzhayyim.esign.signature`. This record is the trigger for anchor-cron to pick up the envelope and write an L2 anchor receipt. Immutable — does not change as anchoring progresses (anchor outcome is recorded separately in `com.etzhayyim.esign.anchoredEvent`).

envelopeUri.description: AT URI of the completed envelope.

documentCid.description: IPFS CID of the signed document (copy of envelope.documentCid for indexer convenience).

documentSha256.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 of the document (copy of envelope.documentSha256 for indexer convenience).

signatureUris.description: AT URIs of every `com.etzhayyim.esign.signature` record that closed the envelope. Order matches the envelope's `signers` array; for `parallel` order this reflects completion order.

completedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at the moment the final signature was accepted.
